page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.mn4.large is an x86_64 general purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, providing 2 vCPUs from 1 physical core with 2 threads per core under a shared CPU allocation model. The instance features 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and has a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate lower-tier capabilities. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance score is 1090.78, and the multi-core score is 2067.18. Memory bandwidth tests show 158.75 GB/sec for small cached blocks, which drops to 16.93 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Geekbench results include a single-core score of 939.0 and a multi-core score of 1598.0, while the Passmark CPU score is 2646.42. Redis SET operations reach 2.58 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput is measured at 2.32 GB/sec.

Given its shared CPU allocation and lower benchmark results, the ecs.mn4.large offers a budget-friendly hardware profile for non-critical workloads. The lack of local storage and baseline network bandwidth limits its utility for high-throughput data processing. It is best suited for lightweight general-purpose tasks, basic web serving, development environments, and small-scale testing where resource demands are low and cost efficiency is prioritized over high performance.
